name: medKeyFilter
description: Named preset or custom RegExp used to filter keystrokes and pasted input. Client-side UX convenience only; never a substitute for server-side validation.

name: validateOnly
description: When true, avoids blocking keystrokes and relies on the validate method for UX feedback. Client-side UX control only; always enforce server-side validation.

name: validate
description: Tests whether the provided string matches the configured filter pattern for client-side UX validation (not a replacement for server-side validation).
